# Create instructions for admin_routes.py
Create an admin API router that:
1. Provides endpoints to add, update, and remove model configurations
2. Validates model configurations before updating the registry
3. Implements proper authentication and authorization
4. Supports bulk operations for efficiency
5. Logs all administrative actions for audit purposes
6. Returns appropriate status codes and error messages
7. Implements idempotent operations with request IDs
8. Supports filtering and pagination for listing operations
